title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’m not going out that way anymore so let me know what time you get off
Sounds good.
What time you thinking
6 something? Depends where you’re at
At my house, was gonna come downtown
Alright, I’ll let you know as soon as I can. Where you wanna meet at?
Doesn’t matter to me...what are you feeling?
Literally anything. Some place that isn’t a big chain
Green Dot?
Lol was gonna suggest that as well. It’s always good.
I’m gonna get ready to get out of here. You wanna meet up soon?
Yeag I’m pulling up
Green dot
Alright, I’m heading to the garage now.
I gotta take a call outside for 10
Got caught up with Mac. Leaving now
Bring your computer in with a phone charger
Parking now. I don’t have a sub port in my computer
USB
Ah ok
